Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Collision Coverage

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

The loss is covered under your collision coverage. According to your policy, [COLL-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

Regarding the settlement, the net payment to you is {PAYOUT}. Please note that the deductible of {DEDUCTIBLE} has already been subtracted from this amount.

As a next step, payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us directly.

Sincerely,

ClaimPilot Claims Team
